meta.name: lsp
meta.description: Use when Codex needs language-server diagnostics, definitions, references, symbols, or rename safety checks in the current workspace.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在编辑器中获取代码诊断、定义跳转和引用查找
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在代码编辑器中快速定位定义、引用或检查重命名安全
copy.tagline_en: Get language diagnostics, definitions, references, and rename safety in your editor
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need quick access to definitions, references, and rename safety in your code editor

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能通过语言服务器检查代码错误、跳转到定义、查找引用、查看符号,还能安全地重命名代码。
howto.when: 当对话涉及代码错误检查、查找定义或引用、重命名安全性等代码分析需求时触发。

say.text: 检查这个文件里的错误。
say.note: 会运行诊断并列出问题。

say.text: 跳转到这个函数的定义。
重命名这个变量,先看看安全吗?
say.note: 会先检查重命名是否有效。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can use language-server tools to check code diagnostics, jump to definitions, find references, inspect symbols, and safely rename code in the workspace.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the conversation involves code-error checks, finding definitions/references, or rename-safety analysis in the current workspace.

say_en.text: Go to the definition of this function.
Is it safe to rename this variable?
